nations.name: Alabama-Coushatta Tribe of Texas
nations.lands: East Texas; the Tribe describes its reservation in the Big Thicket

facts.text: The Tribe's history timeline dates congressional restoration of its federal recognition to 1987. This is a legal-status milestone, not the beginning of the people.
facts.evidence: Restoration Act passes Congress and restores

facts.text: The Tribe's account of 1836 says members guided Sam Houston's army and supplied Texas refugees fleeing Santa Anna's army.
facts.evidence: served as guides for Houston’s army and provided provisions

facts.text: The Tribe describes an elected Tribal Council advised by its Chiefs. The profile concerns this Texas Tribal government, not every Alabama or Coushatta community.
facts.evidence: Tribe of Texas is governed by an elected Tribal Council

facts.text: The Tribe's government page states that its elected Tribal Council members serve three-year terms.
